title: The Story on the Bus
source_notes: Built from the CurioLoop example premise only: a first-person narrator who missed a story told on a school bus; the children who heard it believed it predicted their deaths; his childhood friend refuses to tell him; the narrator finally overhears it and learns the prediction was about him. Names, locations marked script_specified=false, and all physical details are assumptions made for visual coherence and must be replaced by script facts when a real script supplies them.

visual_identity.logline: An ordinary childhood place is slowly drained of safety by something the audience never hears and never sees; dread comes from what is withheld.

palette.name: Bus-Window Grey

colors.usage: Deepest shadow. Never pure black; keep 3-5% detail.
Dominant charcoal surface colour for interiors and night exteriors.
Blue-grey midtones for walls, road, sky.
Brightest values: cold bone-grey, never pure white.
Muted green for bus vinyl seats and roadside foliage.
Dim tungsten, used ONLY for in-scene lamps. Single warm accent per frame.

palette.max_saturation_note: Overall saturation 10-25%. Practical light may reach 35% in a small area only. No red grading.

lighting_rules: Motivated light only: windows, a single lamp, headlights, a hallway strip. No unexplained glow.
Low-key by default; faces are partially lit or turned away; never lit evenly.
Warm practical light is a single small island in a cold frame; it never fills the room.
Memory scenes (childhood) are slightly softer and lower in contrast than present-day scenes; present-day scenes are harder-edged.

preferred_shots: wide shots with uncomfortable negative space
long-lens compression of the seat rows
movement_rules: Default is static or a barely perceptible push-in (scale change 0.05 or less).
Movement speeds up only for realisation beats; stillness for dread beats.
No handheld shake. Micro-drift allowed in the final overhearing sequence only.
forbidden: face reveals of the unseen narrator

texture.notes: Fine analog grain, slight halation on practical lights. No VHS corruption packs; distortion is restrained to one-frame softness shifts at most.

characters.name: Daniel
characters.narrative_role: First-person protagonist who missed the story and later learns it was about him.

states.label: Narrator, present day

appearance.face: never shown frontally; if a profile is unavoidable keep it in shadow
appearance.hair: short dark hair, greying at the temples
distinguishing: a plain steel wristwatch on the left wrist

states.reference_description: A man of about 41, average height and lean, short dark hair greying at the temples, steel wristwatch on his left wrist, wearing a charcoal wool overcoat over a dark grey sweater; shown from behind, in profile shadow, or as a silhouette, never face-on.
allowed_changes: posture becomes more rigid as the story progresses
overcoat collar up in colder scenes

states.label: Narrator as a child

distinguishing: scuffed knee visible below shorts or trousers

clothing: worn backpack with one strap loose
states.reference_description: A thin boy of about nine with short, slightly uneven dark hair, in a navy hooded jacket with a worn backpack hanging from one strap; seen from behind or from a distance, never face-on.

characters.name: Marcus
characters.narrative_role: Childhood friend who heard the story and refuses to repeat it, believing telling it would cause the narrator's death.

states.label: Friend as a child

appearance.height_impression: a little taller than the narrator as a child
appearance.face: round face, serious expression; face shown only in shadowed medium shots

states.reference_description: A slightly stocky boy of about nine with short sandy-brown hair and a serious round face, wearing a green knitted scarf and a grey zip-up jacket.

states.label: Friend, present day

appearance.face: round face now lined, tired eyes; kept in partial shadow
distinguishing: a green scarf of the same dark muted green

states.reference_description: A solid man of about 41 with short receding sandy-brown hair, a lined round face with tired eyes kept partly in shadow, wearing a dark muted-green scarf and a grey wool cardigan.
allowed_changes: scarf on or off depending on indoor/outdoor
more visible fatigue as the story progresses

characters.name: The children on the bus
characters.narrative_role: The group who heard the story and later believed it predicted their deaths. Shown only as an anonymous cluster.

states.label: Children on the bus

appearance.face: never individually shown; backs of heads and silhouettes only
appearance.hair: varied dark and brown tones, no individually defined hairstyles

states.reference_description: A cluster of anonymous school children in muted dark jackets, seen only as backs of heads and silhouettes, huddled close together a few rows back.

locations.name: School bus interior
locations.description: A long, aging school bus interior with rows of green vinyl seats, a narrow aisle, and tall dusty windows. It is the origin of the story and must feel ordinary, slightly worn, and quietly wrong.
architecture_and_layout: narrow central aisle running toward the rear
paired seats on both sides, green vinyl with taped repairs
tall windows with metal frames, condensation at the lower edge
driver's seat and large mirror at the front

variants.lighting: low, diffused sun through dusty windows; long soft shadows down the aisle
grey blue light from windows, one dim overhead lamp
variants.weather_or_atmosphere: fog on the glass, interior slightly cooler

continuity_locks: Seat colour is always muted green vinyl.
Aisle always runs toward the rear with the clustered children several rows back.
The seat nearest the camera (the narrator's) stays visually empty or partially in frame in memory shots.

locations.name: Rural bus route road
locations.description: A quiet, two-lane rural road with a gravel shoulder, wet-looking asphalt and a distant tree line, where the bus stops and the narrator waits in childhood and returns in adulthood.
architecture_and_layout: two-lane road bending out of frame
a bare tree line on one side
a plain metal bus-stop post without branding

variants.lighting: flat blue-grey ambient light, soft headlamp glow far down the road

variants.weather_or_atmosphere: still air, thin mist near the tree line

continuity_locks: Same road bend, bus-stop post on left, tree line on right in every episode.
The road is empty of vehicles unless the script requires one.

locations.name: Friend's home, kitchen
locations.description: A modest, tidy kitchen with a small wooden table and a single hanging lamp, where the friend's refusal is shown; the room feels still and over-controlled.
architecture_and_layout: small rectangular wooden table at centre
one window over the sink, curtains half drawn
a doorway to a dark hallway on the right
a single hanging lamp above the table

variants.lighting: one warm hanging lamp; the rest of the room falls into cool shadow
variants.weather_or_atmosphere: still air, faint steam from a cup optional

continuity_locks: The doorway to the hallway is always on the right side of the table.
Only one warm light source per frame.

locations.name: Threshold where the story is overheard
locations.description: A dim hallway or doorway threshold from which the narrator hears the story through a partly open door; the audience hears the voice but the story's content is withheld from the visuals.
architecture_and_layout: narrow hallway ending at a partly open door
a thin vertical strip of warm light from the room beyond
plain walls, a coat hook, bare floor
fixed_elements: partly open door at end of hallway

variants.lighting: hallway in cold darkness; narrow warm vertical light strip from the door
variants.weather_or_atmosphere: still, silent air; faint dust in the light strip

continuity_locks: The door is always at the far end of the hallway, partly open, with a vertical light strip.
The narrator is always seen from behind in this location.

recurring_objects.name: Green vinyl bus seats
recurring_objects.description: Muted-green vinyl seat rows with taped cracks, repeated in memory shots as the visual shorthand for the story's origin.
recurring_objects.narrative_significance: Anchors every flashback to the bus without showing the story's content.

recurring_objects.name: Narrow vertical door light
recurring_objects.description: A thin vertical band of warm light through a partly open door.
recurring_objects.narrative_significance: Visual echo that links the friend's kitchen doorway to the final overhearing threshold.

motifs.description: A seat in the foreground that nobody occupies.
motifs.meaning: The narrator's absence from the moment the story was told.
motifs.usage_limit: At most once per episode, and only in memory scenes.

motifs.description: A cluster of children seen only from behind.
motifs.meaning: A shared knowledge the narrator is excluded from.
motifs.usage_limit: Never show a face; never more than 6 heads.

motifs.description: Doorways and narrow openings framing the narrator.
motifs.usage_limit: Increase frequency across episodes; must be present in the final scene.

continuity_constraints: The story's content is never visualised; only reactions, spaces and consequences are shown.
The narrator's face is never shown; all adult shots use back, profile shadow or silhouette.
Muted-green seats, the friend's green scarf, and foliage share the same desaturated green (#5B6B58 family).
Warm light (#C9B27A) is always a motivated practical source and never exceeds one source per frame.
Memory scenes use childhood states only; present scenes use adult states only. Never mix eras in one frame.
The visual identity may only tighten (more negative space, longer stillness) as tension rises; it may not change palette or grain.
negative_constraints: No monsters, ghosts, glowing eyes, blood or gore.
No red colour grading or red emergency lighting.
No visible text of the story, no readable supernatural symbols.
No face shown for the narrator.
No additional characters beyond those listed.
No bright, saturated or cartoon-like colours.

closing_visual_state.description: The narrator, seen from behind in his charcoal overcoat, stands alone on the empty rural road looking down the bend as thin mist gathers near the tree line.

continuity_ledger.next_opening_state: Same road bend and mist, then a slow dissolve toward the friend's home.

closing_visual_state.description: The friend, face half in shadow, sits very still at the kitchen table beneath the single lamp while the hallway doorway at the right of the frame stays dark.

continuity_ledger.next_opening_state: The dark hallway doorway becomes the narrow vertical door light of the overhearing threshold.

implementation_notes: Renderer-independent: nothing here assumes an image-generation provider; realise with whatever the repository's renderer supports (CSS gradients, SVG silhouettes, supplied images, canvas layers).
All unspecified details are assumptions and must be replaced by facts from the actual script when available.
